qemu_behavior: MSI delivery is handled by QEMU's software interrupt-controller model, without an Apple Hypervisor.framework provider result.
bridgevm_behavior: The native Apple GIC backend advertises GICM_SET_SPI_NSR at 0x08080040 and MSI INTIDs 128 through 191. Any nonzero hv_gic_send_msi result stops the run through the existing fatal lifecycle path; the diagnostic retains the message vector, guest-programmable address and data, raw status, drain location, exit and PC. Attempted deliveries are counted and the unattempted batch tail is not sent or replayed.
impact: Malformed guest MSI configuration can also produce a provider rejection and terminate the run. A raw status does not establish whether the cause was guest configuration or a provider failure; no ignore or retry guarantee is made. The optional userspace GIC backend's existing delivery behavior is unchanged. This policy is covered by deterministic injected-provider tests, not a live guest compatibility result.
